actual_implementation_rows.existing_proof_domain: All well-typed original no-std states on x86_64, in the recorded debug/release profile. Fresh regenerated-body and integrated Lean evidence extends the previous std-only domain.
actual_implementation_rows.remaining_obligations_or_blocker: This establishes the recorded method body, not Debug, inherited Hasher defaults or alias collection behavior.

supplemental_evidence.guarantee: The exact original no-std translated Lean body is byte-identical to its std counterpart and is freshly checked against the same fourteen behavioral theorems.
